description: Defines the dmrs_type class for handling DM-RS configurations in 5G NR, including resource element calculations, patterns, and port support.

classes.name: dmrs_type
classes.description: Represents DM-RS types for PDSCH and PUSCH, providing methods for resource calculations, patterns, and configuration.

methods.name: nof_dmrs_per_rb
methods.description: Returns the number of resource elements carrying DM-RS per resource block for the given DMRS type.

methods.name: dmrs_max_ports_type
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of ports supported for the current DMRS type.

methods.name: get_dmrs_prb_mask
methods.description: Generates a resource element mask within a PRB indicating DM-RS positions based on CDM groups.

methods.name: get_dmrs_pattern
methods.description: Creates a resource element pattern for DM-RS transmission, including symbol and resource block masks.

methods.name: to_string
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the DMRS type.
